The structure of Gd6Ce2S12 (reduced formula Gd3CeS6) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over 5 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Ce and Gd centers as octahedrally coordinated by six S neighbors, while S centers show two-, three-, or four-coordinate environments. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Ce and Gd octahedra, and corner-sharing among like-centered octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites.
